title: Yellow Gooey Middle Eastern Frankfurter Hummus
description: A unique and delicious midnight craving dish featuring frankfurter and a mother-sauce-base, this hummus is floral and gooey, perfect for satisfying your snack cravings, it is also onion and garlic free.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chickpeas, lemon juice, tahini, olive oil, paprika, and salt.
Blend the mixture on high speed for about 2 minutes, or until smooth and creamy.
Add the cooked and diced frankfurter to the blender and blend until well combined.
With the blender running, slowly add the water and continue blending for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding more lemon juice, salt, or paprika to taste.
If desired, add the yellow food coloring and blend until the color is evenly distributed.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Yellow Gooey Middle Eastern Frankfurter Hummus immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
Just before serving, give the hummus a good stir and adjust the consistency as needed by adding a little more water.
